a job DELETED on the PC while its went off notification is still posted leaves the notification up for ever - nothing cancels it, because the PC's changed event is the only cancellation this app has and a job that no longer exists sends none. Measured on the owner's CPH2419 (adb f0a5b32b) on 2026-10-11: POST /api/schedule/act {id,do:delete} for s7623a9a982 and sf50b6d4930 both answered {ok:false,reason:no_such_job}, GET /api/schedule showed jobs:[se80955f188] and went_off:[], and both tags were still posted - tag=s7623a9a982 channel=jarvis_alarm flags=ONGOING_EVENT|INSISTENT|AUTO_CANCEL|LOCAL_ONLY category=alarm actions=2 and tag=sf50b6d4930 channel=jarvis_schedule actions=1 - so the alarm kept ringing with no event left to cancel it. Fixed on this branch by cancelling any schedule notification whose job is in none of GET /api/schedule's jobs/todo/went_off, only after a read that SUCCEEDED | CLOSED ON THE REAL DEVICE 2026-10-11 (owner's CPH2419, adb f0a5b32b), check (b): with the job aged out of jobs+todo+went_off (listed = FALSE) and tag=s1106891920 still posted (TRUE), one successful GET /api/schedule from a clean launch (Find -> "coming" -> Coming up) left the tag GONE (posted = FALSE) - the state that made the alarm ring for ever is now cancelled by the reconcile. Three earlier attempts were inconclusive and were NOT reported as results: a forced delete 404'd (no_such_job, so a fired job cannot be removed through the API at all - it can only age out of went_off after an hour, filed separately), and two runs where the navigation never reached Coming up so the app never read the schedule (a false negative from the instrument, not the code)
